text.autoconfig.lunge-launch.title: Lunge Launch Config
text.autoconfig.lunge-launch.option.acti: Delay in milliseconds before activating elytra after using lunge spear. Useful for high ping servers. Default: 0ms (instant)
text.autoconfig.lunge-launch.option.crou: When enabled, crouching will prevent elytra from activating. Default: ON
Allows using lunge spear while already flying with elytra. Default: OFF
